entities.summary: Karl Zsigmondy was an Austro-Hungarian mathematician. He was a son of Adolf Zsigmondy from Pozsony, Kingdom of Hungary and his mother was Irma von Szakmáry of Martonvásár, Kingdom of Hungary.
